verdict.rationale: Exporting secrets is a fair question for an authenticator app, but no first-party documentation describes any export feature. The only backup mentioned is encrypted cloud sync to Authy's own service, which does not let users leave for another app. Community reports consistently say Authy deliberately makes export hard or impossible. The only way out is user-side hacks (debug-mode Electron scripts, a deprecated Chrome extension with gist JavaScript, third-party tools), which earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
